result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but there is a clear data-formatting bug in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where a delivery fee shows as 'NaN', plus a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between cards.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, exposing an unparsed/undefined numeric value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee before formatting; fall back to a sensible label such as 'Free delivery', '—' or hide the fee line when the value is missing or not a number.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, which reduces visual consistency and contrast.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color and opacity) across all restaurant cards, ensuring sufficient contrast over any image.
